correctness.rationale: The sole fold is cell w=n-q-1 with slope -(n-1); all other cells translate with unit slope. Mod-d residues give a length-(m-1) forced string ending at the hub plus d-1 disjoint deterministic m-cycles receiving but not returning edges, yielding the block determinant and entropy. Their iterate m translates each cell to itself, proving neutral identities; any itinerary using the fold has derivative magnitude >=n-1 and cannot be identity on an interval. For gcd=1 all closed Markov walks traverse an expanding fold and identify one unique periodic fixed point per walk, with boundary addresses checked against the n-knot orbit, giving trace(M^k), determinant zeta, and hub return lengths. Independently built all 44 transition matrices for 3<=n<=10 and all q and checked their entire symbolic characteristic polynomials; separately enumerated exact rational closed-itinerary points for (n,q)=(3,1),(4,1),(4,3),(5,2) at k<=6 without duplicates. These finite checks support but do not prove the all-parameter result.
